scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0016; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: What time?, At six. and the shorter Six. are natural in a context where the next walk is already established.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Learner-facing Persian preserves the intended meaning and now uses «بخش» instead of the hamza-bearing «جزء», matching Nova orthography rules without changing the task.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: The schedule task contrasts time with a room-number interpretation, checking the information type as well as the digit.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: The load was reduced to time, six and at; seven is deferred.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: Reading a simple schedule extends earlier label/number reading into time.

overallCoherence.evidence: The Lesson has one communicative job: understand and state the next walk time.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: Real learner outcomes and delayed retention have not been measured.
Generated audio still requires perceptual/prosody review with human listeners.
Hidden-answer retrieval remains bounded and cannot certify open-ended language ability.
Quality v3 remediation was model/editor reviewed; real learner evidence is still required before public-release readiness.
